title: AI-Driven Wireless Audio Conference System for Smartphone
summary: MUST pilots a smartphone audio system with automated speaking queues and transcription. Lower equipment costs and smoother participation are expected.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MUST pilots a smartphone audio system with automated speaking queues and transcription. Lower equipment costs and smoother participation are expected.
purpose: Make meetings easier to organize and participate in through existing smartphones.

ratings.reason: Pilots are described, but smoother participation and transcription benefits are presented as expected impacts.
Lower equipment and staffing costs are expected. Observed savings remain unreported.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 14: AI-Driven Wireless Audio Conference System for Smartphone

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Participating phones and the server on the same local Wi-Fi network
Compatibility with the venue public-address system

headline: Smartphones become AI-managed meeting microphones
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
